messages.subject: Project Northwind — COMPLETED — executed A&R Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Claire, Gavin,

I'm pleased to confirm that the amendment and restatement of Sutherland's facilities has completed today. All CPs (other than the post-completion filings) are satisfied or waived as set out in the checklist. The Facility B advance of £3.5m and the amendment fee of £285k will settle per the funds flow this morning.

The executed Amendment and Restatement Agreement is attached. We will deal with the MR01 filings and the Land Registry application in the usual time limits and circulate a completion bible.

Thank you all for a constructive process.

Best,
Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0534
